tasks.title: Initialize backend project structure (Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)
tasks.title_zh: 初始化后端项目结构（Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL）
tasks.description: Set up Node.js + Express server, configure Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, define all 13 database models from PRD Section 4.

tasks.title: Implement HQ Auth + Master Catalog CRUD API
tasks.title_zh: 实现总部认证 + 母产品库增删改查 API
tasks.description: HQ admin login (JWT), CRUD for master_brands, master_devices, master_categories, master_products. See PRD Section 5.3.

tasks.title: Implement Merchant Auth + Pricing API
tasks.title_zh: 实现商户认证 + 定价 API
tasks.description: Merchant login, browse master catalog with own prices overlaid, sync/update merchant_products, shop settings CRUD. See PRD Section 5.2.

tasks.title: Implement Client Browse + Search + Shop API
tasks.title_zh: 实现客户端浏览 + 搜索 + 店铺 API
tasks.description: List brands/devices/services, LBS-based shop search with distance sorting (Haversine), shop detail with services & reviews. See PRD Section 5.1.

tasks.title: Implement Booking + Stripe Deposit API
tasks.title_zh: 实现预约 + Stripe 定金支付 API
tasks.description: Create booking, generate QR code, Stripe Checkout Session for 20% deposit, webhook handler, merchant check-in/complete/no-show. See PRD Sections 5.1-5.2 & 12.

tasks.title: Implement Warranty + Commission APIs
tasks.title_zh: 实现保修 + 佣金 API
tasks.description: Auto-create warranty on booking completion (180 days), cross-shop claims, commission rules engine (global/region/merchant priority resolution). See PRD Sections 5.1-5.3.

tasks.title: Set up React Router + Layout + Auth Context
tasks.title_zh: 配置 React Router + 布局 + 认证上下文
tasks.description: Install react-router-dom, set up all routes per PRD Section 3.3, create API client (axios), auth context for customer/merchant/HQ. Clean up old dead code (src/data/, src/logic/, src/merchant/Dashboard.jsx, src/customer/Home.jsx).

tasks.title: Build C-End: HomePage + SearchPage + ShopPage
tasks.title_zh: 构建客户端：首页 + 搜索页 + 店铺微站
tasks.description: Homepage with brand grid + search, search results with map toggle (Google Maps), shop micro-site with tabs (Services/About/Reviews). See PRD Section 7.1.

tasks.title: Build C-End: BookingFlow + Confirmation + WarrantyWallet
tasks.title_zh: 构建客户端：预约流程 + 确认页 + 保修钱包
tasks.description: 4-step booking flow (date→time→details→summary), Stripe redirect, booking confirmation with QR, booking history, warranty wallet. See PRD Section 7.1.

tasks.title: Build Merchant-End: Dashboard + Pricing + Scan + Settings
tasks.title_zh: 构建商户端：仪表盘 + 定价 + 扫码 + 设置
tasks.description: Merchant dashboard (today stats + timeline), pricing table (toggle/price from master catalog), QR scanner, shop settings (hours, photos, slots). See PRD Section 7.2.

tasks.title: Build HQ-End: Catalog + Merchants + Commission + Finance
tasks.title_zh: 构建总部端：产品库 + 商户管理 + 佣金 + 财务
tasks.description: HQ master catalog CRUD table, merchant list (pending/active/suspended tabs), commission rules editor (scope/rate/priority), finance ledger tabs. See PRD Section 7.3.

tasks.title: Write API integration tests + E2E booking flow test
tasks.title_zh: 编写 API 集成测试 + E2E 预约流程测试
tasks.description: Test full booking lifecycle: create booking → pay deposit → check-in → complete → warranty issued. Test commission calculation. Test auth flows.
